lines.en: -Thank you so much. I hope he wasn't a handful.
-Not in the slightest. As the Germans would say,
and so now I'm fluent in German --
-April and Andy went away for the night,
and I looked after Champion here.
I got him various toys, got him shots,
got him groomed, and gave him plenty of exercise.
-Dogs tend to take on the personalities of their owners,
so if you were to sit on your couch all day
watching cartoons and eating nothing but Cheetos,
that's what he would want to do, too.
-Who wouldn't? That sounds like an amazing day.
